messages:
Alyssa Chen: FYI — prepping materials for BluePeak renewal next week. Need to confirm the SLA numbers we'll present in the renewal deck and whether any onboarding/latency credits apply. Customer asked for uptime history + the credit calc for last month's latency spike. @Raj can you pull uptime/latency table? @Emma can you confirm if the p95 regression was a model rollout or infra blip? Need a one-pager by EOD tomorrow.

Raj Patel: On it — pulling SLO telemetry now. Quick summary from last 30d: uptime 99.978% (no full outage), p50 ~65ms, p95 ~235ms. I see a tail spike on 2026-02-11 03:22 UTC. I'll paste the table below.

Emma Rivera: That 02/11 spike matches a canary model rollout. We saw KV-cache misses as the cache warmed which caused higher token latencies for some request profiles. We rolled back the canary and warmed caches; no downtime.

Mike O'Neill: Contract SLOs: monthly uptime 99.95%; p95 latency target 220ms. Our credit policy: credits apply when the latency SLO is breached for >2% of the minutes in the billing period (per contract). BluePeak's p95 was above target but only ~1.8% of minutes, so per-contract they don't automatically qualify. Will confirm with legal.

Olivia Park: Renewal risk note — BluePeak brought this up on the last call and asked for a clear RCA + mitigation plan before signing. They want a short customer-facing summary and an internal action queue that we can use in the renewal deck.

Alyssa Chen: Action items: (1) Raj — attach raw CSV + a tiny chart here, (2) Emma — write a short RCA paragraph for the deck, (3) Mike — confirm credit calc with legal and recommend whether to offer goodwill credit, (4) Olivia — I will draft the customer-facing note and share for approval. Meeting Friday 10:00 AM PT to review. Sound good?

Raj Patel: Uploading CSV and chart link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/bluepeak/1987654321
CSV snapshot:
```
time,p50_ms,p95_ms,uptime_percent
2026-02-01,60,180,100
2026-02-11,62,240,99.997
2026-02-12,61,200,99.999
2026-02-28,64,220,99.99
```
Will attach full export to the shared drive.

Emma Rivera: RCA paragraph for the deck:
"On 2026-02-11 we observed an elevated p95 latency during a canary model rollout. Root cause: cache warmup and increased KV cache misses for a subset of request paths during the rollout. Mitigation: revert rollout, staged ramp with traffic priming, and a cache warmup job. Permanent guardrails: add canary warmup traffic to rollout playbook and automated evals to detect tail-latency regressions. Patch deployed 2026-02-13."

Mike O'Neill: Legal confirmed the threshold is >2% to trigger formal credit. BluePeak had ~1.8% of minutes above threshold so no mandatory credit. My recommendation: include an optional goodwill credit in the deck (5% invoice credit for one month) to de-risk renewal negotiations.

Olivia Park: +1 to the 5% goodwill offer. We'll use it as a negotiation lever and only apply if they push. Please mark it as "optional" in the customer-facing slide.

Alyssa Chen: Thanks — I'll draft the 1-pager and the internal action queue and post here by EOD. Meeting invite sent for Fri 10:00 PT. If anyone adds anything else, drop it below.
